subject.title: fix(agent): harden execution and session boundaries

question: Should the stricter provider terminal contract, tool-capability opt-in for newly discovered models, and persisted-timestamp session behavior become the supported upgrade behavior?
rationale: These changes are internally coherent but deliberately make some previously tolerated provider and configuration states fail closed or require operator action.

options.title: Accept the strict boundaries
options.body: Merge after confirming the new provider, model-discovery, and legacy-session behavior is the intended compatibility contract.

options.title: Preserve compatibility defaults
options.body: Keep existing behavior by default and introduce strict handling only through an explicit migration or opt-in policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the strict boundaries
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the new provider, model-discovery, and legacy-session behavior is the intended compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The git history identifies this person as the owner of the released agent runtime and immediately preceding continuity design.
